meta.proposer: claude (propose-once / freeze / replay; same protocol as s6e1/s4e1/s6e2/s3e7)
meta.strategy: Pool lacks shallow XGB (only depth 5-6) and shallow CatBoost (only 7-9). Inject bias-dominated depth-2/3 MAE-objective members of the under-represented families to decorrelate the mid/deep pool (the s6e1/s4e1 archetype). Params within s3e14 whitelist; MAE objectives (regression_l1 / MAE / reg:absoluteerror).

proposals.expected: Solo MAE ~342-345 (above the mid-depth members) but lowest error-correlation; realistic shot at nonzero blend weight.
proposals.rationale: Pool XGB is only depth 5-6. A depth-3, gamma+reg-heavy MAE XGB is bias-dominated -> maximal decorrelation (the s6e1/s4e1 winning archetype).

proposals.expected: Solo MAE ~342-345; shallow ordered-boosting MAE CatBoost, differently-correlated error surface than shallow XGB.
proposals.rationale: Pool CatBoost is only depth 7-9. A depth-3, high-l2 MAE CatBoost adds a second bias-dominated family for decorrelation.

proposals.expected: Solo MAE ~343-347; an extreme-bias depth-2 extra-trees L1 LGB, most decorrelated of the three.
proposals.rationale: A depth-2 num_leaves-4 extra_trees L1 LGB is a heterogeneous bias-dominated member; suboptimal-but-diverse is an asset (INT-04).
